problem: The existing thin native plugin-runtime reconcile adapter caps HTTP request timeout by an absolute monotonic deadline, but its 1ms floor can exceed a sub-millisecond remaining budget. A Windows test also compared a computed float to the nominal 50ms literal and can fail from large-monotonic floating-point representation.

selected.implementation: Keep the existing N.E.K.O native HTTP lifecycle authority and existing reconcile adapter. For deadline-bound calls, return min(preferred, actual positive remaining) with no minimum floor; make the unit test deterministic by patching monotonic time and add a sub-millisecond regression.

considered.outcome: selected; this is the already-reviewed explicit/startup recovery seam
rejected; would not improve this synchronous urllib absolute-budget arithmetic

considered.candidate: Relax the flaky assertion with epsilon
considered.outcome: rejected because it would leave the real sub-millisecond deadline overrun possible

acceptance: _bounded_timeout never returns a value greater than actual positive remaining budget
sub-millisecond remaining budget is not inflated to 1ms
no-deadline preferred timeout retains the existing >=1ms normalization
existing native reconcile tests remain green
retirement_condition: Retire this XiaoYu helper only when N.E.K.O exposes an equivalent native bounded reconcile operation that removes the thin adapter entirely.
